title: DOLA supply centers on FiRM and the Peg Stability Module
description: Inverse Finance documents DOLA as primarily created through overcollateralized FiRM borrowing with a USDS-backed Peg Stability Module as the secondary issuance and peg-defense route.
notes: This event records the current protocol model rather than the original launch. FiRM is a later backing-model transition from DOLA's 2021 Anchor origin.

title: Inverse Finance launches Anchor and DOLA
description: Inverse Finance opened the Anchor money market, now called Frontier, on February 25, 2021. The protocol facilitated DOLA issuance, establishing the original public launch boundary for the continuing DOLA asset.
notes: The canonical Ethereum token contract was created on 2021-02-23. Contract deployment and the exact first mint are separate from the documented public protocol launch.

title: COTI launches Djed on Cardano
description: Djed launched on Cardano using ADA reserves and the SHEN reserve coin within an overcollateralized reserve-ratio system.
notes: Launch date follows the official Cardano ecosystem record.

title: Venus operates VAI with stability fees and peg-support modules
description: Venus documentation describes VAI as a USD-pegged protocol stablecoin supported by collateralized minting, a variable stability fee, and a Peg Stability Module.
notes: Exact initial launch date is not asserted in this batch.

title: HAY is rebranded as lisUSD
description: Lista DAO completed the Helio-to-Lista transition on February 5, 2024 and renamed HAY to lisUSD. The BNB Chain stablecoin remained the continuing HAY-derived token.
notes: The rebrand date is not the asset launch date. HAY remains a historical alias.

title: USK recorded with limited current status
description: Official USK documentation remains available and describes minting, burning, collateral, and liquidation, but current unrestricted mint-interface and successor-ecosystem operation could not be fully verified.
notes: This is a registry review event, not a claim that USK has formally terminated.

title: Helio Protocol launches HAY on BNB Chain
description: Helio Protocol launched mainnet on August 19, 2022, allowing users to deposit BNB collateral and borrow HAY. This is the canonical launch of the asset now branded lisUSD.
